n90a5e2165a.headline: Emerging markets - Thai stocks post biggest drop in five weeks as Asia FX mixed as markets mull future Fed rate stance
n90a5e2165a.summary: Emerging Asian currencies were mixed on Monday and several regional stock markets eased after sharp gains the previous session. Thai stocks posted their biggest drop in five weeks.
n90a5e2165a.why: Thailand's SET index tracks the country's largest listed companies, and regional markets respond closely to US Federal Reserve policy expectations.
n90a5e2165a.why_moved: Investors weighed the likelihood of the US Federal Reserve softening its hawkish monetary policy after sharp gains in the previous session.

n782bce8fc7.headline: Elevated expressway start construction in Bangladesh
n782bce8fc7.summary: Construction began Saturday in Dhaka on the China-funded Dhaka-Ashulia Elevated Expressway. The project is an infrastructure development in the Bangladeshi capital.
n782bce8fc7.why: Large infrastructure projects funded by foreign lenders shape Bangladesh's growth, transport capacity and external debt exposure.

na60a73387e.headline: Dangerous Ken Ofori-Atta has squandered GHS12.4m oil money to pay judgment debt; he must go – Ablakwa
na60a73387e.summary: Ghanaian MP Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa repeated his call for Finance Minister Ken Ofori-Atta to be sacked, accusing him of using GHS12.4m of oil money to pay a judgment debt.
na60a73387e.why: Ghana's finance ministry manages public debt and oil revenues, so leadership changes and fiscal controversies affect investor views of Ghanaian sovereign risk.

n6183cd2080.headline: Volvo CEO Jim Rowan predicts EV pricing will drop to ICE levels by 2025
n6183cd2080.summary: Volvo Cars CEO Jim Rowan predicts electric vehicle prices will drop to the level of fossil-fuel cars by 2025. He said this could happen sooner rather than later.
n6183cd2080.why: Volvo Cars is a Swedish carmaker, and the pricing of electric vehicles relative to combustion models influences demand and margins across the auto industry.

n0bdc52fbce.headline: Vodacom spends record R5.8bn on SA network as it battles load shedding
n0bdc52fbce.summary: Vodacom has spent a record R5.8bn on its South African network as it battles load shedding. Energy supply challenges and inflationary pressures added pressure on the business, though customers showed resilience, it said.
n0bdc52fbce.why: Vodacom is a major South African mobile operator, and network capital spending and power-supply disruptions affect its margins and capital allocation.

n1e3ab2de67.headline: Pan Asia Banking :  Interim Financial Statements for the nine months ended 30th September, 2022
n1e3ab2de67.summary: Pan Asia Bank released interim financial statements for the nine months ended 30 September 2022. The bank said its first nine months reflected resilience amid challenging conditions.
n1e3ab2de67.why: Pan Asia Banking Corporation is a Sri Lankan commercial bank, and its results give investors a view of the local banking sector's health.

n64024c863c.headline: Harnessing the potential of intercontinental expansion in African fintech
n64024c863c.summary: Nigeria's startup ecosystem has grown significantly over the past decade. A Partech report says $1.8 billion was invested in Nigeria in 2021, 34% of the total.
n64024c863c.why: Venture capital flows into African fintech shape the growth of payments and lending companies across the continent.

n42b2b73625.summary: A draft map of the Residential Zoned Land Tax is available, with the tax to apply from 2024 to zoned residential lands, including greenfield and brownfield sites.

n846540f616.summary: Greece reissued a bond attracting bids of 1.026 billion euros, with 200 million euros finally accepted, indicating investor confidence in Greek debt markets.

n0c6dfff857.summary: Water scarcity and climate change issues are being discussed at COP27, with implications for resource management and economic stability.

n331170383a.headline: ‘Like an ocean’: Molong devastated by deluge with more NSW towns hit with fresh flooding
n331170383a.summary: Flooding in New South Wales causes regional disruptions, potentially impacting local economies and infrastructure.
n331170383a.why: Natural disasters can affect regional economic activity, infrastructure resilience, and insurance markets.

n068cb09979.headline: Biden Left One Major Topic Out of His Conversation With China's President
n068cb09979.summary: The White House reports that President Biden did not discuss a major topic during his three-hour meeting with China's leader.

n9479ebc941.summary: Sri Lanka's president has proposed more than doubling the country's tax revenue to help resolve its severe economic crisis.

n6554ff8d9a.headline: Liberia's First Retail Shopping Facility, Monrovia Mall, Breaks Ground on Wednesday
n6554ff8d9a.summary: The first modern retail shopping mall in Liberia, Monrovia Mall, begins construction, indicating expansion of retail infrastructure.

n332c603eb4.headline: WB to grant loan for beautification of Dhaka
n332c603eb4.summary: The World Bank will provide a loan to Bangladesh for a project to improve urban aesthetics in Dhaka, one of the world's most congested cities.
n332c603eb4.why: Urban development funding can influence local infrastructure, economic activity, and investment climate in Bangladesh.

nc8e4764d79.headline: STOCK MARKET NEWS: Amazon layoffs, FTX fallout, stocks slip ahead of retail earnings
nc8e4764d79.summary: US stocks declined as investors awaited retail earnings, amid ongoing FTX crisis and falling oil prices, with market sentiment cautious.

nd292626577.headline: Azerbaijan’s transformation into an IT hub: reality and prospects | The Jerusalem Post
nd292626577.summary: Azerbaijan is transforming into an IT hub, with regional geopolitical significance and potential economic growth.
nd292626577.why: Development as an IT hub can attract foreign investment and diversify Azerbaijan's economy.

n72f482e02e.headline: SpaceX Just Bought a Big Ad Campaign on Twitter for Starlink
n72f482e02e.summary: SpaceX ordered a large advertising package from Twitter to promote Starlink satellite internet services.
n72f482e02e.why: Increased marketing efforts can expand Starlink's market share and revenue potential.

n8e87a50b60.headline: Australia’s life expectancy has risen to third-highest in the world
n8e87a50b60.summary: Australia's population now has an average life expectancy of 84.3 years, driven by COVID-19 containment and healthcare quality.
n8e87a50b60.why: Higher life expectancy reflects healthcare investment and economic stability, influencing social policy and healthcare markets.

nec7b96ebdf.headline: National Bank of Greece to issue five-year bond

nec7b96ebdf.why: Bank bond issuance impacts capital ratios, lending capacity, and financial stability in Greece.

n9cc238fc37.headline: Americana Restaurants IPO covered within hours of its launch
